item.text:
Created [index.html](./index.html) as the only file in the working directory. It includes the simulator, deterministic 100-second replay, instanced 3D battlefield, combat and collapse effects, wordless HUD, playback controls, and synthesized audio.

Both reference hashes matched in Chromium: `82a5353d` and `2e8858d7`. The simulator uses the air lane’s **2,800-centi-tile waypoint length** because the stated 2,600 did not reproduce the reference vectors.

The strategy concentrates cannon fire on clusters and uses bolts and flak for air coverage. It averaged **43.824 waves across ten non-42 seeds**, including five held out from tuning. Seed 42 scored **42.93** and fell at tick **1,737**.

I verified Re-fire, endpoint behavior, and pixel-identical frames after scrubbing away and back. Desktop GPU frame rate and audible mix quality remain unverified.
